material.description: blocked_by for gap-moba-kill-bounty. Done: bce518d (on origin main) declares creep bounty=25 in scenarios/moba/units_extra.osd (compiles; the image differs by one byte from the file-less build) and adds resource_a:[side0,side1] to GET /state (probed live on oscraftd: resource_a:[0,0]). Blocked: no route or Room accessor injects a kill. oscraftd serves GET state, delta, catalog, order POST only; room.rs has no sim mutator, and the gate test_room builds a Room with data None. The witness needs one deterministic kill on the live room: either a scripted kill hook (owner to choose) or an /order attack chain run until a side 1 creep dies, then assert resource_a[0] rises by 25 against the pre-kill /state. Stale-binary note: target/debug/osdt-data predated format 15 and refused the moba scenario (model= extra); rebuilt, now exit 0.
